title: Proton Drive synced folder
whyItMatters: Proton Drive keeps a local File Provider folder on the Mac. Files that never uploaded stay in a dated folder after sign-out, so they can contain private documents.
source: Proton Support, How to use Proton Drive on macOS: signed-out files stay in ~/Library/Cloud Storage/ProtonDrive-<account> (<timestamp>) - https://proton.me/support/drive-macos-guide
notes: Covers the live folder and the dated ProtonDrive-<account> (<timestamp>) folders Proton Drive leaves after sign-out. Online-only placeholders are counted, not hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any file that has not uploaded to Proton Drive to a drive you keep; signing out leaves it in a dated ProtonDrive folder.
cleanup.signOut: In the Proton Drive menu bar icon, sign out of the app so it stops syncing this Mac.
steps: Wait for uploads to finish and copy any file that fails to upload.
In the Proton Drive menu bar icon, sign out of the app.
Delete the ProtonDrive folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Local copies on this Mac are removed. Files already in the Proton Drive account are untouched; files that never uploaded are deleted if they are not copied first.
cleanup.source: Proton Support, How to use Proton Drive on macOS: https://proton.me/support/drive-macos-guide
